purpose: Teach: 雅子/恵子/静香/直人/健一/和夫/篤/哉

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、社会で雅子様の御活動について調べてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were studying Masako's public activities for your social studies report, weren't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing challenge. Leaning forward slightly. Quick pace, knowing eyes. Testing whether he'll admit or deflect.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお母様、恵子さんって名前だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your mom's name is Keiko, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Calm counter-observation. Quiet delivery. No accusation — just stating fact back at her. Slight pause before her name, like he's making his point.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、隣のクラスの静香と話してたな
lines.en: Riku — you were talking to Shizuka from the next class, weren't you?
lines.style: Sharper edge now. Not angry, but pressing. Quick attack on the opening. Eyes narrowed with amusement at his own game being played back.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サッカー部の直人先輩を尊敬してたな、桜
lines.en: You really look up to Naoto-senpai from the soccer club, don't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Steady, almost gentle observation. No teasing lilt — just accurate. He's not performing, just mirroring her rhythm. Slight warmth under the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、健一おじさんが家に来てたな
lines.en: Riku — your Uncle Kenichi was at your house the other day, wasn't he?
lines.style: Back to the light challenge. Quicker pace. Small smile in the voice — she's enjoying this and he's noticing. Eyebrows up slightly.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、家庭科の先生、和夫先生だったよな、桜
lines.en: Your home economics teacher is Kazuo-sensei, right, Sakura?
lines.style: Even delivery, no flourish. He's settled into his rhythm now — matching her tempo exactly. The slightest curve to his voice that says he knows she knows he knows.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、「篤実」って言葉、漢字練習で書いてたな
lines.en: Riku — you were practicing writing that kanji, 篤実, for your character drills, weren't you?
lines.style: Speeding up slightly. Lighter attack. She's enjoying this back-and-forth too much to stop now. Breathier on the opening.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、古文で「哉!」、つまり「〜哉!」って読み方習ったろ、桜
lines.en: You learned about the classical reading 哉 — you know, 〜哉 — in your old literature class, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Close, almost conspiratorial. Slow on the explanation, fast on her name at the end. He's caught her at something and they both know it. Small laugh underneath.
